blocks.text: HOARDING CLEANOUT FAQ
Hoarding Cleanouts in Schomberg — Honest Answers to Common Questions

items.q: What's the cost to clean out a hoarder's house in Schomberg?
a: Hoarder clean out cost depends on the volume of belongings and how many rooms or buildings are affected — a single room prices modestly, a full property with an outbuilding costs more given the time required. The exact figure is confirmed free at a private walkthrough, with no village premium anywhere.

items.q: Is a hoarding cleanout really discreet in a village this small?
a: Especially in a village this small, yes. Unmarked scheduling on request, no commentary, and arrival times arranged around quieter hours. Schomberg notices — but never because of us.

items.q: Do you charge extra for rural properties or hamlet homes?
a: Never. The same flat pricing applies at Main Street, in Lloydtown, Pottageville or Kettleby, and on a farm well out on the concessions.

items.q: What's the best way to clean out a hoarder's house?
a: Professional help, a clear plan, and patience. Going in without a strategy usually causes more distress than progress. The most effective approach sorts systematically — keep, donate, recycle, dispose — and moves at a pace the household can handle.

items.q: Can the cleanout include a barn or outbuilding, not just the house?
a: Yes — it’s regular work for us on the township’s farm properties, all under one flat, honest price.

items.q: Can the cleanout happen while the person continues living in the home?
a: Yes, and it’s one of the most common ways a hoarding cleanout actually happens. Work can proceed room by room while the resident stays in place throughout.

items.q: What happens if we find valuables, documents or sentimental items?
a: They’re set aside immediately and brought to the family or resident, never sorted into a donation or disposal pile by default.

items.q: What if the property has safety hazards — pests, mould, structural damage?
a: Those get flagged honestly. Live Junk Free doesn’t disturb suspected biohazards or structural issues — the concern is identified and the household is pointed toward the right licensed specialist before the rest of the cleanout proceeds.
